description: Invalid and deprecated optimizer modes through an Environment (P29): Twig builds the OptimizerNodeVisitor when the extensions are initialized (ExtensionSet::initExtensions()), which the lexer does before it lexes the first template, so compileSource() wraps the InvalidArgumentException of an invalid mode even for a template with a syntax error, and the mode deprecations come first, once per environment. With the SandboxExtension, getTemplateClass() initializes the extensions first (getSandboxSignature()), so load() throws the raw InvalidArgumentException. The oracle ran every case in its own PHP process (batch optimizer_mode_env.gen.json, "isolation": "process"): in one process a class compiled by an earlier case is not compiled again, which hides the deprecations. Record again with: twig-fuzz record tests/vectors/visitors/optimizer_mode_env.gen.json --out <file> --description <text>, then restore the notes and the known_mismatch reasons.
